title_en: Sima Guang Smashes the Water Jar

sentences.zh: 很久以前，中国有一个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn jiǔ yǐqián, Zhōngguó yǒu yí gè háizi.
sentences.en: Long ago, there was a child in China.

sentences.zh: 他叫司马光，非常聪明。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiào Sīmǎ Guāng, fēicháng cōngming.
sentences.en: His name was Sima Guang, and he was very clever.

sentences.zh: 有一天，他和朋友们在花园里玩。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, tā hé péngyoumen zài huāyuán lǐ wán.
sentences.en: One day, he was playing with his friends in the garden.

sentences.zh: 花园里有一个大水缸。
sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ yǒu yí gè dà shuǐgāng.
sentences.en: In the garden there was a big water jar.

sentences.zh: 水缸很高，里面都是水。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐgāng hěn gāo, lǐmiàn dōu shì shuǐ.
sentences.en: The jar was tall, and it was full of water.

sentences.zh: 一个孩子爬到了水缸上面。
sentences.pinyin: Yí gè háizi pá dào le shuǐgāng shàngmiàn.
sentences.en: One child climbed up onto the top of the jar.

sentences.zh: 一不小心，他掉进了水缸里。
sentences.pinyin: Yí bù xiǎoxīn, tā diào jìn le shuǐgāng lǐ.
sentences.en: He was not careful, and he fell into the jar.

sentences.zh: 水缸很大，水也很深。
sentences.pinyin: Shuǐgāng hěn dà, shuǐ yě hěn shēn.
sentences.en: The jar was big, and the water was deep.

sentences.zh: 那个孩子出不来了。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge háizi chū bu lái le.
sentences.en: The child could not get out.

sentences.zh: 他的头也在水里了！
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tóu yě zài shuǐ lǐ le!
sentences.en: Even his head went under the water!

sentences.zh: 别的孩子都很害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Bié de háizi dōu hěn hàipà.
sentences.en: The other children were all very scared.

sentences.zh: 他们又哭又叫，不知道怎么办。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòu kū yòu jiào, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
sentences.en: They cried and screamed, and they did not know what to do.

sentences.zh: 然后，他们跑出去找大人。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tāmen pǎo chūqu zhǎo dàren.
sentences.en: Then they ran outside to find grown-ups.

sentences.zh: 但是司马光没有哭，也没有跑。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì Sīmǎ Guāng méiyǒu kū, yě méiyǒu pǎo.
sentences.en: But Sima Guang did not cry, and he did not run.

sentences.zh: 他看着水缸，认真地想。
sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn zhe shuǐgāng, rènzhēn de xiǎng.
sentences.en: He looked at the jar and thought hard.

sentences.zh: 突然，他想到了一个好办法。
sentences.pinyin: Tūrán, tā xiǎng dào le yí gè hǎo bànfǎ.
sentences.en: Suddenly, he thought of a good plan.

sentences.zh: 地上有一块大石头。
sentences.pinyin: Dìshang yǒu yí kuài dà shítou.
sentences.en: There was a big stone on the ground.

sentences.zh: 司马光把大石头拿起来。
sentences.pinyin: Sīmǎ Guāng bǎ dà shítou ná qǐlai.
sentences.en: Sima Guang picked up the big stone.

sentences.zh: 他用力砸那个水缸。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng lì zá nàge shuǐgāng.
sentences.en: He hit the water jar as hard as he could.

sentences.zh: 砰的一声，水缸破了！
sentences.pinyin: Pēng de yì shēng, shuǐgāng pò le!
sentences.en: With a bang, the jar broke!

sentences.zh: 里面的水都流了出来。
sentences.pinyin: Lǐmiàn de shuǐ dōu liú le chūlái.
sentences.en: All the water inside flowed out.

sentences.zh: 司马光救了那个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Sīmǎ Guāng jiù le nàge háizi.
sentences.en: Sima Guang saved the child.

sentences.zh: 虽然司马光很小，但是他不害怕。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán Sīmǎ Guāng hěn xiǎo, dànshì tā bú hàipà.
sentences.en: Although Sima Guang was little, he was not afraid.

sentences.zh: 遇到事情，他总是先想好办法。
sentences.pinyin: Yù dào shìqing, tā zǒngshì xiān xiǎng hǎo bànfǎ.
sentences.en: When something happened, he always thought of a good plan first.

sentences.zh: 大家都说，他像个小大人。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu shuō, tā xiàng ge xiǎo dàren.
sentences.en: Everyone said he was like a little grown-up.

sentences.zh: 这就是“司马光砸缸”的故事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì “Sīmǎ Guāng zá gāng” de gùshi.
sentences.en: This is the story of “Sima Guang Smashes the Jar”.

sentences.zh: 因为这件事，司马光就很有名了。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì, Sīmǎ Guāng jiù hěn yǒumíng le.
sentences.en: Because of this, Sima Guang became famous.

sentences.zh: 有人画了很多画，讲这个故事。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu rén huà le hěn duō huà, jiǎng zhège gùshi.
sentences.en: People drew many pictures to tell this story.

sentences.zh: 看画的人越来越多。
sentences.pinyin: Kàn huà de rén yuè lái yuè duō.
sentences.en: More and more people looked at the pictures.

sentences.zh: 今天，人们还在讲这个故事。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān, rénmen hái zài jiǎng zhège gùshi.
sentences.en: Today, people still tell this story.

key_vocabulary.en: water jar; a big clay pot for holding water (also called 缸)
jar; vat (short form of 水缸, used in the story's title)
to fall; to drop (掉进 = to fall into)
to use one's strength; hard, with all one's force
to smash; to hit something hard
bang! (the sound of a hard hit)
